panels.title: What this dashboard can and cannot tell you

options.content: Figures are **accrued cost as reported by the generation pipeline**, not a provider invoice. A model served from a cache tier reports zero cost, so a fall in spend can mean either less work or more cache hits -- the *Generations by origin* panel separates them. **An empty panel means no generation has ever reported that series, which is not the same as zero spend:** if the collector is unreachable the cost is being incurred and not recorded. Check *Telemetry pipeline health* on the infrastructure dashboard before concluding spend is low.

defaults.__comment: noValue is the word, not a zero. A stat panel defaulting to 0 is exactly the plausible-number-from-a-dead-source failure.

panels.description: Input and output are separate because they price differently on every provider, so a combined total cannot be converted back into money.

panels.title: Generations by origin
panels.description: Where each answer came from. A rise in cache hits lowers spend without lowering work, so this is what makes the cost panels interpretable.
